newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - June 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - June 2.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.

- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - Bilateral trade between Hong Kong and Shanghai has increased 25 percent annually since the start of the 1990s with trade volume hitting $40.7 billion yuan in 1996 against $1.695 billion in 1989.

- BUSINESS NEWS - More foreign firms in Shanghai have started employing qualified Chinese people to heads their offices in China with more than 200 local people now assuming the post of chief representative or senior adviser in Shanghai.
